name: player_compute_triangle_normal
description: Player::ComputeTriangleNormal builds an upward-facing normalized terrain normal from three probe points.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so cross-product ordering, zMath::Vec3Normalize codegen, and caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42ce50 validates edgeAB/edgeAC subtraction from point A, cross-product normal construction, zMath::Vec3Normalize, upward flip when normal.y <= 0, and storage into playerState->steerBasisRef.
The native smoke verifies both negative-Y flip and already-upward normal cases.
